tierReason.zh: 衍射辅助治疗，治疗能力强但输出偏低
tierReason.en: Spectro support/healer with strong healing but lower personal damage

name: 西格莉卡
description: 罗伊族的少女，原秘日六席候补，星炬学院的助教。与达妮娅和娜波摩为好友。
descriptionEn: She is a student in the Preparatory Program at Startorch Academy and a member of its Birding Fan Club as well as a Solsworn from the Roya Tribe.

tierReason.zh: 气动输出，技能组合灵活，适配气动队
tierReason.en: Aero DPS with flexible skill combos, fits well in Aero teams

name: 达妮娅
description: 星炬学院的学生，西格莉卡的好友。她暗中作为残星会的特工行动，隐藏着不为人知的秘密。
descriptionEn: She is a student from Startorch Academy's Department of Voidmatters who secretly serves as an agent for the Fractsidus.

tierReason.zh: 热熔输出，技能倍率优秀，输出环境良好
tierReason.en: Fusion DPS with excellent skill multipliers and comfortable damage windows

name: 绯雪
description: 星炬学院传说中的巫女，同时也是「特别对策组」的成员。她与鸣灾者有着悠久的联系。
descriptionEn: She is a miko and member of the Special Response Force with a long-standing connection to the Threnodian.

tierReason.zh: 冷凝主C，技能优雅高伤，冷凝队核心输出
tierReason.en: Glacio main DPS with elegant and high-damage skills, core Glacio team carry

name: 露西
description: 赛博朋克：边缘行者联动角色，以衍射属性佩枪进行强力输出。
descriptionEn: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collaboration character. A Spectro Pistols main DPS with powerful damage output.

tierReason.zh: 衍射主C，赛博朋克联动限定角色，输出能力极强
tierReason.en: Spectro main DPS, Cyberpunk collab limited character with excellent damage output

basicAtk.description: 进行光谱属性的连击攻击，积累光谱能量。
basicAtk.descriptionEn: Performs Spectro combo attacks to build Spectro energy.

name: 丽贝卡
description: 赛博朋克：边缘行者联动角色，导电属性佩枪角色，活动期间免费获取。
descriptionEn: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collaboration character. An Electro Pistols character available for free during the event.

tierReason.zh: 导电输出/辅助，赛博朋克联动免费角色，性价比极高
tierReason.en: Electro DPS/support, Cyberpunk collab free character with great value

basicAtk.description: 使用双枪进行快速射击，造成雷属性伤害。
basicAtk.descriptionEn: Fires rapid shots with dual pistols, dealing Electro DMG.

name: 洛瑟菈
description: 星炬学院校长，冷凝属性音感仪角色，拥有快速切换和冷凝焦灼机制。
descriptionEn: Principal of Startorch Academy. A Glacio Rectifier sub-DPS with quick-swap and Glacio Chafe mechanics.

tierReason.zh: 冷凝副C，快速切换机制与冷凝焦灼配合出色
tierReason.en: Glacio sub-DPS with excellent quick-swap mechanics and Glacio Chafe synergy

basicAtk.description: 进行至多五段的冷凝属性连击攻击，快速积累冷凝能量。
basicAtk.descriptionEn: Performs up to 5 consecutive Glacio attacks, rapidly building Glacio energy.

skill.description: 释放积累的冷凝能量，对前方大范围敌人造成冷凝伤害并施加冷凝焦灼效果。
skill.descriptionEn: Releases accumulated Glacio energy to deal Glacio DMG to enemies in a large area and apply Glacio Chafe.

ultimate.description: 创造超低温领域，对领域内敌人造成持续冷凝伤害并降低其移动速度。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Creates an ultra-low temperature field dealing continuous Glacio DMG and reducing movement speed of enemies within.
